0000.note: The Rust kernel rewords some error messages; same errors otherwise (languages/l0000/CLAUDE.md, "The Rust implementation").

The Rust kernel reports each error's real source position (from/to) where the TypeScript reports -1, rewords some messages, and doesn't repeat errors the TypeScript reports twice (languages/l0000/CLAUDE.md; crates/core/tests/conformance.rs). Data and status are identical. Accepted 2026-10-29 for L0000's switch (A4).

0179.note: An upstream {data, errors} envelope is unwrapped by the Rust kernel: its fields are laid over the output and its params/limit read; TypeScript spreads the envelope itself (languages/l0179/CLAUDE.md, "Conformance"). Kept, not copied (P4 decision 2026-10-28).

0180.note: The TypeScript PROG spreads options.data raw, so an envelope's data and errors keys go into the item; the Rust kernel unwraps it and spreads the learner's response (languages/l0180/CLAUDE.md). Kept, not copied (P4 decision 2026-10-28).
